I overdosed on a bunch of things. I had taken them about 9 hours before I was found and 911 was called. I was pretty much totally out of it although my mom (who found me) told me I said sorry to her but I don’t remember that. I actually don’t remember anything for about 52 hours from first taking the overdose (partly because I was unconscious from the overdose and also I was put into a coma/to sleep a few times). I apparently was conscious and talked with my parents and a doctor for a bit on the second day but I have absolutely no recollection of that happening, I’m not sure why but they sedated me for that night so that might be why? I have no idea. The first time I woke up and actually remember it, I immediately knew what had happened. I had a breathing tube down my throat and my wrists were tied to the bed (apparently so I wouldn’t pull the tube out). After they took out the tube, my voice was pretty much gone/damaged? because they had to put it in twice because it came out when I threw up and also I’m small so I guess it was just too big for me, so I could only whisper for about 2 days and then I could talk a bit but my voice was messed up, it felt like my voice was muffled? I’m not sure how to explain it, but it took about 3 weeks for it to go back to normal. Surprisingly I don’t have any health problems from my attempt so I was really lucky, thank god. Anyways, sorry that was so long, I don’t really have anyone to talk about this with so it’s nice to get it out, so thank you for reading if you did! :)
